Act as the review sub-agent for this task.

You are a Senior Code Reviewer. Review round 5 of an implementation plan + spec (no implementation code exists yet). Prior round had 0 Critical + 11 Important; verify the 11 claimed fixes below and hunt for remaining gaps. Be strict on Critical/Important; Minor may be skipped.

FILES (repo root C:\Project\ninfs-mcp, read both fully first): docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-08-ninfs-mcp.md (rev5), docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-ninfs-mcp-design.md (rev6).

CLAIMED FIXES THIS ROUND:
1. Same-Python: all ninfs invocations are [sys.executable, "-m", "ninfs", <kind>, ...]; verification uses python -m ninfs <kind> --help (verified working dispatch in ninfs 2.0 __main__.py).
2. check_no_overlap(workspace, sd_root) explicit input, called after selection before staging creation; Task 1 tests it.
3. Highs 00040000+0004000e accepted; base->update-preferred, explicit-update direct without base fallback; 3-state tests.
4. Completeness = parseable TMD + index-0 .app present non-empty; broken updates fall back to base.
5. Staging .mounts/<mount_id>/<handle_id|sd>/<kind> supports concurrent handles; sequential same/different title tests.
6. InternalMount.secrets snapshot; session sd_root feeds all sanitize calls incl. post-invalidation; retry-after-delete sanitization test.
7. Every unmount + startup sweeps all residuals; pre-ID failures kept and swept; deleted-ID unmount routes to residuals else unknown-id.
8. Exited proc: skip terminate/wait but ALWAYS verify staging (exited+nonempty/listdir-failure = residual).
9. Server calls runner via anyio.to_thread; cooperative cancel at op boundaries; replace-boundary semantics (pre-replace cancel keeps old file, post-replace committed); MCP cancel-notification tests with mock runner.
10. First-component .mounts reserved from dest (direct + symlink); overlap/secret-dest rejection.
11. ID state machine fixed (validation-fail keeps session reusable; child-fail no handle; extract-fail invalidates handle; extract-success handle reusable; unmount invalidates all).

SPEC CONTEXT: Windows+WinFsp, stdio, ninfs 2.0 CLI via subprocess only (-f always, stdout DEVNULL, stderr drain thread 64KB), 5 tools, runner-internal dataclasses mapped to public dicts by server (detect_sd dict-return documented exception), read-only enforced, get_secrets()+session paths sanitizer, three-stage path checks, mocked tests only, Native execution, Tasks 1-5 TDD + Task 6 manual, per-commit security-audit quick + final independent review.

CHECKS: (a) each claimed fix is real and sufficient; (b) no new contradictions; (c) explicit Task 1 startability; (d) type/key consistency; (e) remaining spec-silent behaviors.

OUTPUT: ### Strengths; ### Issues (#### Critical/Important/Minor with file:line+why+fix); ### Recommendations; ### Assessment (Ready: Yes/No/With fixes + reason, PLUS explicit line "Task 1 startable: Yes/No" with reason). Before verdict list out-of-scope items one line each with reason. Read-only: mutate nothing, spawn no subagents.
